memory: I didn't just discover a song; I discovered that the moment itself mattered. It was the sudden, overwhelming realization that an opportunity can actually change the entire trajectory of your life, and that the stakes of the present are incredibly real.
hardHittingLine:
The moment, you own it, you better never let it go (Go)

You only get one shot, do not miss your chance to blow

This opportunity comes once in a lifetime
whyThisLine: Because it framed life not as an endless series of tomorrow, but as a finite, once-in-a-lifetime window where you either own the moment or let it go.
